H1601.derivation: feminine active participle of H1600 (גָּעָה); lowing;

H1602.def: to detest; by implication, to reject
H1602.kjv: abhor, fail, lothe, vilely cast away.

H1610.derivation: from an unused root meaning to arch;
H1610.def: the back; by extension the body or self

H1612.derivation: from an unused root meaning to bend;
H1612.def: a vine (as twining), especially the grape

H1613.derivation: from an unused root, probably meaning to house in;
H1613.def: a kind of tree or wood (as used for building), apparently the cypress

H1614.def: properly, cypress-resin; by analogy, sulphur (as equally inflammable)

H1615.def: lime (from being burned in a kiln)

H1616.def: properly, a guest; by implication, a foreigner

H1617.def: Gera, the name of six Israelites

H1618.derivation: from an unused root meaning to scratch;

H1619.derivation: from the same as H1618 (גָּרָב); scabby;
H1619.def: Gareb, the name of an Israelite, also of a hill near Jerusalem

H1620.def: a berry (as if a pellet of rumination)

H1622.derivation: patrial from an unused name (of uncertain derivation);
H1622.def: a Girgashite, one of the native tribes of Canaan

H1624.def: properly, to grate, i.e. (figuratively) to anger

H1626.derivation: from H1641 (גָּרַר) (as in H1625 (גֵּרָה)); properly, (like H1620 (גַּרְגַּר)) a kernel (round as if scraped), i.e.
H1626.def: a gerah or small weight (and coin)

H1630.derivation: plural of an unused noun from H1629 (גָּרַז) (compare H1511 (גִּזְרִי)), cut up (i.e. rocky);

H1632.kjv: man of great (as in the margin which reads H1419 (גָּדוֹל)).

H1633.derivation: a primitive root; to be spare or skeleton-like; used only as a denominative from H1634 (גֶּרֶם);
H1633.def: (causative) to bone, i.e. denude (by extensive, craunch) the bones

H1634.def: a bone (as the skeleton of the body); hence, self, i.e. (figuratively) very

H1637.derivation: from an unused root meaning to smooth;
H1637.def: a threshing-floor (as made even); by analogy, any open area

H1638.def: to crush; also (intransitively and figuratively) to dissolve

H1639.def: to scrape off; by implication, to shave, remove, lessen, withhold
H1639.kjv: abate, clip, (di-) minish, do (take) away, keep back, restrain, make small, withdraw.

H1641.def: to drag off roughly; by implication, to bring up the cud (i.e. ruminate); by analogy, to saw

H1642.derivation: probably from H1641 (גָּרַר); a rolling country;

H1643.derivation: from an unused root meaning to husk;

H1644.def: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce
H1644.kjv: cast up (out), divorced (woman), drive away (forth, out), expel, [idiom] surely put away, trouble, thrust out.

H1647.def: Gereshom, the name of four Israelites

H1648.derivation: or גֵּרְשׁוֹם; from H1644 (גָּרַשׁ); a refugee;

H1649.def: a Gereshonite or descendant of Gereshon

H1650.derivation: from an unused root (meaning to join); bridge;

H1651.def: a Geshurite (also collectively) or inhabitants of Geshur

H1654.derivation: or (prolonged) גַּשְׁמוּ; the same as H1653 (גֶּשֶׁם);

H1655.def: used in a peculiar sense, the body (probably for the (figuratively) idea of a hard rain)

H1657.def: Goshen, the residence of the Israelites in Egypt; also a place in Palestine

H1660.derivation: probably from H5059 (נָגַן) (in the sense of treading out grapes);
H1660.def: a wine-press (or vat for holding the grapes in pressing them)

H1662.derivation: or (abridged) גִּתָּה־חֵפֶר; from H1660 (גַּת) and H2658 (חָפַר) with the article inserted; wine-press of (the) well;

H1663.def: a Gittite or inhabitant of Gath

H1666.def: Gether, a son of Aram, and the region settled by him

H1667.derivation: from H1660 (גַּת) and H7416 (רִמּוֹן); wine-press of (the) pomegranate;

H1672.kjv: be afraid (careful, sorry), sorrow, take thought.

H1673.derivation: or (fully) דּוֹאֵג; active participle of H1672 (דָּאַג); anxious;

H1679.derivation: from an unused root (compare H1680 (דָּבַב)) (probably meaning to be sluggish, i.e. restful);

H1681.derivation: from H1680 (דָּבַב) (in the sense of furtive motion);

H1682.derivation: or (shortened) דְּבֹרָה; from H1696 (דָבַר) (in the sense of orderly motion);

H1683.derivation: or (shortened) דְּבֹרָה; the same as H1682 (דְּבוֹרָה);
H1683.def: Deborah, the name of two Hebrewesses

H1686.derivation: in the margin for the textual reading, חֶרְיוֹן; both, (in the plural only and) of uncertain derivation,
H1686.def: probably some cheap vegetable, perhaps a bulbous root

H1687.derivation: or (shortened) דְּבִר; from H1696 (דָבַר) (apparently in the sense of oracle);
H1687.def: the shrine or innermost part of the sanctuary

H1688.derivation: or (shortened) דְּבִר; (Joshua 13:26 (but see H3810 (לֹא דְבַר))), the same as H1687 (דְּבִיר);
H1688.def: Debir, the name of an Amoritish king and of two places in Palestine

H1689.derivation: probably an orthographical error for H7247 (רִבְלָה);

H1690.derivation: from an unused root (akin to H2082 (זָבַל)) probably meaning to press together;

H1691.derivation: dual from the masculine of H1690 (דְּבֵלָה); two cakes;

H1692.def: properly, to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere; figuratively, to catch by pursuit
H1692.kjv: abide fast, cleave (fast together), follow close (hard after), be joined (together), keep (fast), overtake, pursue hard, stick, take.

H1696.def: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H1696.kjv: answer, appoint, bid, command, commune, declare, destroy, give, name, promise, pronounce, rehearse, say, speak, be spokesman, subdue, talk, teach, tell, think, use (entreaties), utter, [idiom] well, [idiom] work.

H1697.def: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H1697.kjv: act, advice, affair, answer, [idiom] any such (thing), because of, book, business, care, case, cause, certain rate, [phrase] chronicles, commandment, [idiom] commune(-ication), [phrase] concern(-ing), [phrase] confer, counsel, [phrase] dearth, decree, deed, [idiom] disease, due, duty, effect, [phrase] eloquent, errand, (evil favoured-) ness, [phrase] glory, [phrase] harm, hurt, [phrase] iniquity, [phrase] judgment, language, [phrase] lying, manner, matter, message, (no) thing, oracle, [idiom] ought, [idiom] parts, [phrase] pertaining, [phrase] please, portion, [phrase] power, promise, provision, purpose, question, rate, reason, report, request, [idiom] (as hast) said, sake, saying, sentence, [phrase] sign, [phrase] so, some (uncleanness), somewhat to say, [phrase] song, speech, [idiom] spoken, talk, task, [phrase] that, [idiom] there done, thing (concerning), thought, [phrase] thus, tidings, what(-soever), [phrase] wherewith, which, word, work.

H1698.derivation: from H1696 (דָבַר) (in the sense of destroying);

H1699.def: a pasture (from its arrangement of the flock)
